BiblicalUsage: Ir-Shemesh is the city of the sun, a town of the tribe of Dan. In Joshua 19:41 it stands in the border list with Zorah and Eshtaol, in the inheritance of Dan toward the hill country.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the city of the sun is named for what it was: a town on the border of Dan, listed among the cities the tribe was given.
